description: The push-catalog contract: a warm-sources plugin initializes immediately and then PUBLISHES its canonical catalog as a notification — the host owns the store and the first paint never waits on a plugin. Every row carries the first-class manifest-declared source name and a non-empty title. An authoritative-empty publish is legal (netinfo with no interfaces, snippets with nothing configured, a cleared source are all correct empties — hence no minimum row count), but the publish itself must arrive.
